name: Nutella
siboNotes: Limit to 1 tablespoon serving to minimize fructan load. The inulin content may trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Measure portions carefully as it's easy to exceed low FODMAP serving size
Warm slightly for easier spreading without using more
Mix with rice cakes or gluten-free toast for balanced snack
Store at room temperature for optimal spreading consistency
alternatives: Pure almond butter with dark chocolate chips
Tahini mixed with maple syrup and cocoa powder
Peanut butter with small amount of dark chocolate
Homemade hazelnut butter with cocoa (no added inulin)
nutritionalHighlights: Source of vitamin E from nuts
Contains some protein from hazelnuts and milk
